items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, finally, Jap Allen's band broke up. Ben and Booker went with Blanche Calloway. ... But I was still in Kansas City.

ctx.x: And they thought that Jap Allen had stole the music, and they find that Clyde Hart had transcribed all these music off the records. Brilliant musician.
Anyway, finally, Jap Allen's band broke up. Ben and Booker went with Blanche Calloway.
So Booker Pittman went with Blanche Calloway.
